home.title: IDSS - External Graduate Examination
home.subtitle: External matura preparation through challenges, missions and practice based exclusively on the official exam catalogues.
home.statusBody: The platform is in its preparation phase and is used by IDSS students and teachers. Sign in with the account the school gave you.

errata.hint: The task and the official key stay exactly as printed. A recorded error is shown to students (before answering only that an error exists, after answering also the description) and to teachers when grading.

followUps.hint: The question is accepted provisionally and the named person still has to check it.

search.title: Search the official materials
search.subtitle: Searches only checked questions and confirmed rules of the active catalogues. Every result names its source and page.
search.method: Ask a question or type a term in Bosnian, German or English. Gemini translates the query into all three languages, finds passages of the official materials by meaning and by words, and answers only from them, citing the source. Without a key or semantic index the search works by words.
search.queryHint: For example: how long is the exam, calculator, Perfekt, Hasanaginica.
search.subject: Subject
search.refusal: The official materials contain no answer to this question.
search.empty: The index has no text yet. The Superadministrator builds it with "Build index".

index.title: Search index
index.intro: The index holds checked questions and confirmed rules of the active catalogues. Build it again after new review decisions; existing text stays.

errors.VALIDATION: Enter a question or term of at least 2 characters.

semantic.title: Index for search by meaning
semantic.intro: For every text passage in the index Gemini computes a meaning vector. Only the text of the official catalogues is sent to Google, never user data.
semantic.counts: With a vector: {embedded} of {total} text passages.
semantic.continue: Not everything finished in one step; click again to continue.

semantic.privacy: For search by meaning the query text is sent to Google (Gemini). Do not enter personal data.
semantic.skipped: Text passages skipped: {n} ({detail}). Click again; skipped passages are retried.

search.fallback: Search by meaning failed just now; the results of the search by words are shown.
search.answerNote: The answer comes only from the official materials below; the mark [I1] points to source I1. Check the answer in the source before using it.
search.answerUnavailable: An answer cannot be composed right now ({detail}). Shown are passages whose words match or that clearly stand out by meaning.

palette.intro: Enter how much of the splash background each IDSS colour covers. The total must be 100 %. The change shows the next time the app opens (within one minute).
palette.note: Shares were measured on the rendered screen; the actual share differs by up to about 1.5 percentage points.

app.invalid: Check the values: whole numbers in the allowed range.

exam.title: Mock exam
exam.subtitle: As in the external graduate examination
exam.intro: A mock exam has the same number of tasks, points and duration as the external graduate examination. The app composes the set by the official catalogue, and a teacher checks and approves it before you start. The grade comes from the teacher.
exam.unavailable: The mock exam for this subject is not prepared yet.
exam.noHistory: You have no mock exams yet.
exam.waiting: The set is waiting for a teacher to check and approve it. Once approved, you can start the exam here.

exam.ruleAutosave: Answers are saved every 20 seconds and when you click Save.

exam.discarded: The teacher discarded this set. You can request a new one on the mock exams page.
exam.resultNote: The teacher gave the points. The solution is the official key of the catalogue.

blueprints.title: Exam blueprints
blueprints.hint: The blueprint sets which catalogue tasks the app may put at which position and how many points they carry. It is derived from the official tests and the catalogue. The subject teacher confirms that the blueprint matches these documents; only then can students request a mock exam.
blueprints.confirmQuestion: Do you confirm that the blueprint matches the official tests and the catalogue? Students can then request mock exams.
blueprints.noConfig: There is no blueprint for this subject in the repository.

exam.approvalHint: Check every task and the official key. The set is composed by the confirmed blueprint; approve it or discard it with a reason.
exam.gradingHint: Every answer is shown beside the official key of the catalogue. Choice and true or false tasks are pre-scored by the printed key; the proposal counts until you change it.
exam.confirmApprove: Approve the set? The student can then start it.
exam.newSet: Compose a new set for the same student at once
exam.confirmHint: When every task is graded, confirm the result. The student then sees points, keys and your notes; the result no longer changes.
exam.confirmResult: Confirm the result? Points cannot be changed afterwards.
